Eve,Ⓒa.ⒹpUrvapradozaH.
Ⓑ
 2 Evening, q. v.; ‘to be on the e(ve) of taking place’ upasTA 1 P, pratyAsad 1 P; See Approach.

⒈ Even,Ⓒa.Ⓓsama (in all senses); ‘e(ven) ground’ samapradeSaH-sTalaM-pAwaH-BUmi f.; ‘e(ven)-handed’ samakriya, samadarSin, ‘e(ven) minded’ samacittaBAva, samavftti.
Ⓑ
 2 samareKa, avakra, fju.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹsamIkf 8 U.
Ⓔadv.Ⓓapi; ‘e(ven) though’, ‘e(ven) if’ yadyapi; ‘e(ven) now’ adyApi; ‘e(ven) so’ evameva, evaM, taTEva, aTa kiM; ‘e(ven) as’ yaTA, yaTEva.
Ⓝ[Even]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsamaM, tulyaM; sama, tulya in comp.
Ⓝ[Even]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsamatA, sAmyaM, tulyatA, ekarUpatA, nirvikAratA, &c.

⒉ Even, Evening,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMDyA, saMDyAsamayaH, sAyaMkAlaH, vi-vE-kAlaH, dinAvasAnaM, pradozaH, rajanImuKaM, sAyAhnaH; ‘in the e(vening)’ sAyaM; ‘good e(vening) to you’ SuBaste pradozaH (BUyAt).
Ⓔa.ⒹsAyaMtana (nI f.), prAdozika (kI f.), vEkAlika (kI f.), sAyaMkAlIna.

Event,Ⓒs.ⒹvfttaM, vyatikaraH, vfttAMtaH, GawanA, saM-BavaH, saMgataM; ‘in the e(vent) of’ yadi, cet.
Ⓑ
 2 pariRAmaH, PalaM, anuvfttaM, udBUtaM, uttaraM PalaM.
Ⓝ[Event]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹviKyAta, bahuvfttaviSizwa.
Ⓝ[Event]ual,Ⓒa.ⒹaMtima, aMtya.
Ⓑ
 2 AnuzaMgika (kI f.) anu-vartin, anusArin.
Ⓝ[Event]ually,Ⓒadv.ⒹavaSeze, aMte, aMtataH.

Ever,Ⓒadv.ⒹkadA-cana-cit, kadApi; karhicit, jAtu; ‘not e(ver)’ na kadAcana, na jAtu, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 nityaM, aharniSaM; sadA, sarvadA; ‘for e(ver)’ SaSvat, niraMtaraM; ajasraM, SASvatIH samAH; oft. by ekAMta, atyaMta in comp.; ‘disappeared for e(ver)’ atyaMtaviluptadarSana; ‘lost for e(ver)’ ekAMtanazwa, ‘gone for e(ver)’ asannivfttyE gata, atyaMtagata; ‘e(ver) more’ punaH, itaH paraM; ‘e(ver) and anon’ vAraMvAraM, kAle kAle, muhurmuhuH, muhuH; ‘e(ver) since’ yataH praBfti; ‘e(ver) so little’ [] manAk-Izat-kiyat-kiMcit-api. With adj. ex. by nitya, sadA, &c. in comp.; ‘e(ver) blooming’ nityapuzpa; ‘e(ver) green’ satataharita, amlAnaparRa; ‘e(ver) lasting’ nityasTAyin, nitya, akzayya, amara; See Eternal; ‘e(ver) moving’ sadA-nitya-gati.

Every,Ⓒa.ⒹEx. by prati-anu- in comp.; ‘e(very) day’ pratidivasaM; prativarzaM, anudinaM, &c., oft. by repeating the word; ‘in e(very) place’ sTAne sTAne; divase divase ‘e(very) day’ &c.; ‘at e(very) discussion’ vAde vAde.
Ⓑ
 2 sarva, viSva, sakala; See Each; ‘knowing e(very) thing’ sarvajYaH; ‘suffering e(very) thing’ savaMsahA (pfTvI); ‘e(very) one’, ‘e(very) body’ sarvaH, sarvajanaH, pratyekaH, ekEkaH; ekEkaSaH, pfTak pfTak; ‘e(very)-day’, (a.) prAtyahika (kI f.); ‘e(very) thing’ sarvaM; ‘e(very) other’ ekEkaM parityajya anya-apara; ‘in e(very) way’ sarvaTA; ‘e(very) where’ vizvak, sarvataH, sarvatra, yatra tatra; ‘e(very) time’ yadA yadA; ‘on e(very) side’ sarvataH, viSvataH, samaMtataH.
